unresolved_mappings.title: Prelabour Rupture of Membranes
unresolved_mappings.issue: Preterm labour (82): Preterm prelabour rupture of membranes shares the same maternal/fetal risk-assessment framework as preterm labour when it occurs before term.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Macrosomia
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrauterine growth restriction (118-3): No dedicated MCC objective exists for excessive fetal growth; macrosomia is the converse abnormal-fetal-weight scenario within the same fetal-growth-assessment domain as objective 118-3.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Polyhydramnios/Oligohydramnios
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrauterine growth restriction (118-3): No dedicated MCC objective exists for amniotic fluid volume abnormalities; oligohydramnios in particular is frequently associated with, and assessed as part of, the same fetal-growth/wellbeing surveillance objective 118-3 addresses.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Multi-Fetal Gestation (Twin Pregnancy) including Twin-Twin Transfusion Syndrome
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrapartum and postpartum care (80-2): No dedicated MCC objective exists for multiple gestation; chorionicity-based surveillance and delivery planning are shared decision-making questions within the broad intrapartum/postpartum care objective.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Early-Onset Group B Streptococcus Disease
unresolved_mappings.issue: Prenatal care (80-1): Routine antenatal GBS screening (35-37 weeks) is part of the prenatal screening this objective covers.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Early-Onset Group B Streptococcus Disease
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrapartum and postpartum care (80-2): Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis decision-making for GBS-positive or risk-factor-positive labour is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective covers.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Amniotic Fluid Embolism
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrapartum and postpartum care (80-2): No dedicated MCC objective names amniotic fluid embolism; it is a rare, catastrophic intrapartum/postpartum event within this objective's broad scope.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Chorioamnionitis
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrapartum and postpartum care (80-2): No dedicated MCC objective names chorioamnionitis; intrapartum infection recognition/management falls within this objective's broad scope.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Chorioamnionitis
unresolved_mappings.issue: Fever and hyperthermia (107-1): Chorioamnionitis is a cause of intrapartum fever that this fever objective requires the candidate to consider and rule out as a serious cause.

unresolved_mappings.title: Meconium (Meconium-Stained Amniotic Fluid)
unresolved_mappings.issue: Intrapartum and postpartum care (80-2): Intrapartum recognition of meconium-stained amniotic fluid and the obstetric decision it prompts falls within this objective's broad scope; neonatal management is a separate downstream competency.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

note: 12 citation(s) carry WEAK mapping_strength evidence across the chapter's 58 total study units, primarily reflecting (a) MCC's presentation-based objective structure lacking dedicated objectives for several individually-named obstetric entities (macrosomia, amniotic fluid volume abnormalities, twin gestation, chorioamnionitis, meconium, postpartum mood changes) -- these are instead captured via targeted search-mcc-objectives calls against the closest broader presentation/umbrella objectives (110-1, 118-3, 80-1, 80-2, 107-1, 59-1) at WEAK/MODERATE strength where a genuine but indirect relationship exists, and (b) one unit (Diabetes Mellitus in Pregnancy) for which no MCC objective evidence exists anywhere in the registry and which is retained as UNCERTAIN with zero evidence rather than asserted as DIRECT/COMPONENT without evidence, per project accuracy rules.
